title: 日本ダービーの後に・天命砕きて至るは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Enduring tough competition from Sakura Chiyono O, Yaeno Muteki, and many others, Mejiro Ardan ultimately surpasses her own limits and claims absolute victory at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Mejiro Ardan basks in the glory of victory, it suddenly strikes her that she had forgotten about her original goal of outshining her older sister, and this brings her to a realization.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She learns that racing with her heart and soul against her cherished rivals, Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki, is the way to make her running shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While expressing the utmost gratitude to her rivals, who have elevated her to greater heights, Mejiro Ardan steps into a new world of possibilities!
